services.answer: Colion International supplies UPS systems, replacement batteries, rack PDUs and surge protection in Dubai and the UAE from APC by Schneider Electric, Eaton, CyberPower and Mercury. We size the UPS to your load and required runtime, then install it so servers, network equipment and PCs shut down safely in a power cut.
intro: A power cut or a voltage dip is the most common reason a server corrupts a database or a switch needs to be reset. A correctly sized UPS keeps equipment running through short interruptions and, in a longer outage, gives it time to shut down cleanly. Sizing is the part most often got wrong: the UPS must cover the real load in watts, with headroom, for the runtime the business needs.

We supply line-interactive [UPS units](/products/ups/) for PCs and small network cabinets, online double-conversion UPS systems for servers and sensitive equipment, rack-mount models with extended battery packs, and the replacement batteries that keep an existing UPS in service. Rack power distribution units and surge protection complete the setup.
Our technicians install the UPS, connect the network management card or USB shutdown software to your servers, and test a simulated outage so you know what will happen when the power actually goes.

faqs.q: What size UPS do I need?
faqs.a: Add up the wattage of everything the UPS will power and choose a UPS rated at least 25–30% above that in watts. For example, a 600 W server and switch needs roughly a 1,000 VA / 800 W UPS or larger. Colion International calculates this for you.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a line-interactive and an online UPS?
faqs.a: A line-interactive UPS switches to battery when the power fails, which suits PCs and small network cabinets. An online double-conversion UPS powers the equipment from its inverter all the time, giving cleaner power with no transfer time, which suits servers and sensitive equipment.

faqs.q: How often should UPS batteries be replaced?
faqs.a: Sealed lead-acid UPS batteries usually last three to five years in UAE conditions, less in hot rooms. Colion International supplies replacement batteries for APC, Eaton and CyberPower units and can test an existing UPS to check its runtime.

intro: An uninterruptible power supply protects equipment from the three things that damage it most: outright power cuts, voltage sags and surges. In the UAE, where most outages are brief, a UPS keeps a server, switch or point-of-sale system running through the interruption, and in a longer cut gives it time to shut down cleanly instead of corrupting data.

Line-interactive UPS units, such as the APC Back-UPS and Smart-UPS ranges or CyberPower's line-interactive models, are the economical choice for PCs, routers and small network cabinets. Sizing is where most UPS purchases go wrong. Add the real wattage of everything to be protected, allow 25–30% headroom, and choose the battery runtime you need. locations.answer: Colion International is an IT hardware supplier in Dubai with two branches in Deira, including its corporate office in Al Dhagaya. We deliver printers, computers, servers, networking and UPS across Dubai the same or next working day, and install them at your office free of charge.
intro: Dubai is home. Our two walk-in branches in Al Sabkha and Al Dhagaya, Deira, sit in one of the city's oldest trading districts, a few minutes from the Creek, and our corporate office sits with the Al Dhagaya branch. Customers from across the city collect from the branches, and our delivery vehicles cover every district from Deira and Bur Dubai to Dubai Marina, Jebel Ali and Dubai Silicon Oasis.

For stock items, orders confirmed in the morning are usually delivered the same day within central Dubai, and next working day elsewhere in the emirate. Free zone companies in JAFZA, DMCC, Dubai Internet City and Dubai Silicon Oasis order from us regularly; we prepare the paperwork their gate and warehouse teams require.

Because our technicians are based in Dubai, installation is on-site and quick: [printers on the network](/services/printing-solutions/), [servers in the rack](/services/server-storage/), and [Wi-Fi across the floor](/services/network-infrastructure/). Visit the [contact page](/contact/) for directions to the branches.

faqs.q: Where is Colion International located in Dubai?
faqs.a: Colion International has two branches in Deira — Shop 1, Al Jaziri Building, Al Sabkha, and Shop 4, Khalifya Building, Al Dhagaya, which is also the corporate office. The branches are open Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 10 PM.

faqs.q: Do you deliver IT hardware the same day in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, for stock items. Colion International usually delivers same day within central Dubai for orders confirmed in the morning, and next working day elsewhere in the emirate.

faqs.q: Do you deliver to free zones like JAFZA and DMCC?
faqs.a: Yes. Colion International delivers to Dubai free zones including JAFZA, DMCC, Dubai Internet City, Dubai Silicon Oasis and DAFZA, with the documentation free zone warehouses require.

intro: Many of our Abu Dhabi customers are companies that want Dubai's wholesale stock and pricing without driving to Deira. We supply them from our Dubai branches and deliver to Abu Dhabi island, Mussafah, Khalifa City, Al Reem and Yas Island, as well as to the industrial and free zones at KIZAD and Masdar City, typically within one to two working days.

Larger orders — an office fit-out, a server room, or a school's computer lab — are delivered on a scheduled date and installed by our technicians on site. Smaller orders and supplies such as toner and UPS batteries are sent by courier.

Abu Dhabi has a high concentration of government, energy and construction organisations, which tend to standardise on [HP](/brands/hp/), [Dell](/brands/dell/) and [Lenovo](/brands/lenovo/) computing and [Cisco](/brands/cisco/) networking. We quote against their specifications and supply VAT invoices with model and serial numbers for asset registers.

faqs.q: Do you deliver IT hardware to Abu Dhabi?
faqs.a: Yes. Colion International delivers from its Dubai branches to Abu Dhabi city, Mussafah, KIZAD, Masdar City and Al Ain, typically within one to two working days.

faqs.q: Can you install equipment on site in Abu Dhabi?
faqs.a: Yes. Colion International schedules on-site installation in Abu Dhabi for servers, networks, printers and computer roll-outs.

faqs.q: Do you have a branch in Abu Dhabi?
faqs.a: No. Colion International's branches are in Deira, Dubai. Abu Dhabi orders are supplied and delivered from Dubai.

Our technicians install on site in Sharjah as they do in Dubai: [network infrastructure](/services/network-infrastructure/), [power protection](/services/power-protection/) and [printers](/products/printers/) configured and tested before hand-over. items.q: How do I get a quotation from Colion International?
items.a: Send the product, model or requirement to Colion International on WhatsApp (+971 50 766 8536), by email to info@colioninternational.com, or through the contact form. The sales desk replies with price, stock and delivery date, usually within business hours the same day.

items.q: Does Colion International sell to individuals or only businesses?
items.a: Colion International is a wholesale supplier focused on businesses, resellers and projects, but it also sells single units to individual customers from its Deira branches and by delivery.

items.q: Is there a minimum order quantity?
items.a: No. Colion International supplies single units as well as bulk quantities. Wholesale pricing improves with volume, and resellers buying regularly can ask for trade terms.

items.q: What payment methods does Colion International accept?
items.a: Colion International accepts cash, credit and debit cards, and bank transfer. Established corporate customers can apply for credit terms.

What has not changed is how we work. We hold real stock in Dubai — the walls of boxed [HP](/brands/hp/), [Canon](/brands/canon/) and [Epson](/brands/epson/) printers in our photographs are our warehouse, not a catalogue — so a customer can order in the morning and receive the same day. Our customers range from a one-person office buying a single printer to system integrators ordering by the pallet and companies exporting to Africa. Each gets the same thing: straight answers on price and availability, and a team that picks up the phone after the sale.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Colion International handles the personal information you share when you contact us or place an order.

paragraphs: **Who we are.** This website is operated by Colion International Trading LLC, Deira, Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Contact: info@colioninternational.com.

**What we collect.** When you send an enquiry we receive the details you choose to share — your name, company, phone number, email address and the products you are interested in. Enquiry forms on this site open WhatsApp or your email application with your message filled in; nothing is stored on this website.

**How we use it.** Only to reply to your enquiry, prepare quotations, process and deliver orders, handle warranty claims, and meet our legal and tax obligations in the UAE. We do not sell your information.
**Analytics.** We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use the site, in aggregate. It sets cookies; you can block them in your browser settings without affecting how the site works.
**Your rights.** You can ask us at any time what information we hold about you, and ask us to correct or delete it, by emailing info@colioninternational.com.

terms.title: Terms of Sale
terms.description: Terms of sale for IT hardware supplied by Colion International Trading LLC, Dubai.

paragraphs: **Quotations.** Quotations are valid for the period stated on them and subject to stock availability at the time of order. Prices are in UAE dirhams (AED) and include VAT where stated.

**Genuine products and warranty.** All products are genuine and supplied with the manufacturer's warranty valid in the UAE. Warranty service is provided by the manufacturer or its authorised service centre; Colion International assists with claims.
**Delivery.** Delivery times are estimates. Risk passes to the customer on delivery. Please check goods on receipt and report any visible damage or shortage within 48 hours.
**Returns.** Unopened products may be returned within 7 days of delivery, subject to inspection, unless they were ordered specially. Opened products are handled under the manufacturer's warranty.
**Trademarks.** Brand names and logos on this site belong to their owners and are used only to identify the products we supply.
